policy: D-104: a field that cannot be obtained is recorded as a gap here and every rule depending on it is switched off and labelled untested. No missing field is approximated, proxied or filled.
scope: shared data prerequisite record only; no Strategy 5-8 work, replay result, alert, order or activation

gaps.field: original point-in-time availability (was this exact value knowable at that historical moment, unrevised)
gaps.reason: EQUS.MINI trades/bbo-1m/ohlcv-1m core17 files (D-102) and the XNYS.PILLAR/EQUS.MINI 13-ETF inventories carry no original-vs-revised flag
dependent_rules_off: any rule scoring or filtering on original-availability

gaps.field: corrections and finality (was a bar/trade later revised or busted)
gaps.reason: no correction/finality feed has been bought or identified for any held dataset
dependent_rules_off: any rule requiring untouched final values

gaps.field: point-in-time index/universe membership (was this symbol actually in scope on that date, e.g. index adds/drops)
gaps.reason: the D-102 17-name and legacy 60-name research sets are current-date lists applied across the whole one-year window; no historical membership feed was bought
dependent_rules_off: Strategy #5 (M10.7) full-breadth point-in-time membership mode; sector-proxy fallback stays separately labeled

gaps.reason: no borrow source was identified or priced under M0.2H/M0.2I; zero requests attempted
dependent_rules_off: any rule gating short-side entries on locate/borrow cost or availability

gaps.field: complete real option chain, full year, all 17 names (every strike/expiration, intraday)
gaps.reason: OPRA full-year chains priced at USD 1,088+, which the USD 60 D-101 budget cannot cover; not bought
dependent_rules_off: any options rule requiring full historical chain replay outside the targeted signal-selected contracts

gaps.field: option intrabar tick path (mbp-1) for the full year
gaps.reason: priced at USD 548 for the equity mbp-1 add-on; deliberately not bought; trades+bbo-1m substitute for intrabar stop/target order and spread estimation, not for tick-level option quotes
dependent_rules_off: any rule requiring true option-quote-tick fill simulation

gaps.field: free DoltHub option reference coverage for 5 of 17 names and intraday timestamps
gaps.reason: QQQ, IWM, GLD, USO, VXX returned zero rows; the source is one end-of-day snapshot per contract with a sampled strike ladder (29-44 of hundreds for SPY), so it cannot price a 0-7 DTE intraday entry/exit for any name
dependent_rules_off: any 0-7 DTE option entry/exit priced from this free source
evidence: trade_alerts_build_docs/ROADMAP.md 'Free option-chain source checked before any option spending' section

gaps.reason: M0.2I V2 narrowed its cost check to the common start date shared by the three priced OPRA schemas; earlier dates remain unpriced and unattempted
dependent_rules_off: any rule requiring option history before 2023-03-28
evidence: trade_alerts_build_docs/ROADMAP.md M0.2I V2 evidence reconciliation section

gaps.field: existing collector date 2026-09-11 option parts, chain and open-interest
gaps.reason: the file-size inventory shows this date lacks option parts, chain and open-interest entirely; presence on other dates does not imply coverage on this one
dependent_rules_off: any continuity claim spanning 2026-09-11 for option chain/open-interest fields

gaps.field: 13-ETF minute inventory: partial opening windows and provider-degraded dates
